content.text: Stripe's availability map covers 46 countries. PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/lemon-squeezy-alternatives-restricted-countries-explained-digital-creators-2|Lemon Squeezy]] Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-stack-started-generating|payment]] infrastructure designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-payments-what-actually-4|COREMERCH guide to nowpayments]] for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Software stripe

Traditional payment processors like Stripe offer convenience and widespread acceptance but restrict access to creators from certain countries. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, such as the Edge Commerce Stack, provides a comprehensive suite of tools for digital creators to host, sell, and deliver products without relying on restricted platforms. This includes hosting, backend logic, order storage, and file delivery, all configured to work seamlessly with cryptocurrency payments.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad's payout delays, Payhip's withdrawal restrictions, and Lemon Squeezy's geographic unavailability all stem from the same root cause: these platforms operate within the traditional financial system. They process payments through Stripe or PayPal on the backend, which means they inherit every restriction those processors impose. When Stripe does not support your country, Gumroad cannot pay you out — regardless of what the platform's feature list implies. Paddle operates as a merchant of record, which creates additional compliance requirements that make it functionally unavailable in most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not platform-level problems. They are financial system problems that only infrastructure built outside that system can solve.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Traditional payment processors offer fast payment processing but charge significant fees, which can eat into creators' profits. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, particularly when using cryptocurrencies for payment, can significantly reduce transaction fees. For example, using NOWPayments with the Edge Commerce Stack allows for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a mere 0.5% fee, making it a more cost-effective solution for digital sales.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers digital creators worldwide.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the critical advantages of sovereign commerce infrastructure is the level of ownership and control it offers creators. Unlike traditional platforms, where the platform retains significant control over sales and customer data, sovereign infrastructure allows creators to own their entire sales stack. This includes automation of payment verification and product delivery, ensuring that creators can focus on producing value rather than managing transactions.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is what infrastructure ownership means.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Break free from payment restrictions with cryptocurrency payments.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy sovereign commerce infrastructure, start by selecting a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, configure backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Set up order storage with Supabase or Google Sheets, and arrange file delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for automatic cryptocurrency payment verification, completing your sovereign sales stack.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is sovereign commerce infrastructure?

Sovereign commerce infrastructure refers to the set of tools and services that allow digital creators to sell and deliver products independently, without relying on traditional restricted payment platforms.
How does NOWPayments work?
NOWPayments is a cryptocurrency payment gateway that allows for automatic on-chain payment verification with a low 0.5% fee, enabling fast and secure transactions.
What countries are restricted by Stripe?
Stripe restricts access to its services in several countries due to regulatory or risk concerns, including Nigeria, Ghana, and others, affecting digital creators' ability to sell globally.
Can I use sovereign commerce infrastructure if I'm not tech-savvy?
Yes, solutions like the Edge Commerce Stack are designed to be deployable by creators of all technical backgrounds, with comprehensive documentation and support available.
Is sovereign commerce infrastructure scalable?
Yes, sovereign commerce infrastructure is highly scalable, allowing creators to grow their businesses without the limitations imposed by traditional payment platforms.
